user.title: Set up CSNet Home
user.description: Enter your CSNet Manager credentials to connect your Hitachi system to Home Assistant.

data.energy_meter: Electricity meter of the heat pump (optional)

data_description.scan_interval: How often to poll for updates (default: 60 seconds)
data_description.language: Preferred language for device names and alarms
data_description.max_temp_override: Override the maximum temperature limit (8-80°C). Leave empty for defaults.
data_description.fan_coil_model: Select the fan coil control type (standard or legacy)
data_description.power_supply: Used to estimate instant power and COP. Auto detects 8/10 HP units as three phase, others as single phase.
data_description.enable_alarm_notifications: Create a Home Assistant notification when the unit reports an alarm
data_description.filtered_alarm_codes: Comma-separated alarm codes that never notify (default: -1, communication errors). Leave empty to notify all.
data_description.energy_meter: Any energy sensor (kWh) that measures the heat pump's electricity, from any device. Used to compute the COP from the heat CSNet records. Leave empty to keep the estimate only.

init.title: Heating curves
init.description: CSNet reports the kind of heating curve (water law) each circuit uses ({circuits}) but not its values. Copy the values your installer set on the unit controller (Space heating > Water calculation mode). They are only used to compute the heating curve water temperature sensors: nothing is sent to the unit. Leave a circuit empty to have no sensor for it.

data.c1_water_at_low_ambient: Circuit 1 – Water set point at low ambient temperature
data.c1_water_at_high_ambient: Circuit 1 – Water set point at high ambient temperature
data.c2_water_at_low_ambient: Circuit 2 – Water set point at low ambient temperature
data.c2_water_at_high_ambient: Circuit 2 – Water set point at high ambient temperature

data_description.c1_low_ambient_temperature: Outdoor temperature of the cold point of the curve
data_description.c1_water_at_low_ambient: Water temperature at the cold point
data_description.c1_high_ambient_temperature: Outdoor temperature of the mild point of the curve
data_description.c1_water_at_high_ambient: Water temperature at the mild point
data_description.c1_gradient: Curve value set on the unit (0.2 to 2.2). The curve starts at 20 °C water for 20 °C outside
data_description.c1_vertex_offset: Shift of the whole curve (-10 to +10 °C). Leave empty for none
data_description.c2_low_ambient_temperature: Outdoor temperature of the cold point of the curve
data_description.c2_water_at_low_ambient: Water temperature at the cold point
data_description.c2_high_ambient_temperature: Outdoor temperature of the mild point of the curve
data_description.c2_water_at_high_ambient: Water temperature at the mild point
data_description.c2_gradient: Curve value set on the unit (0.2 to 2.2). The curve starts at 20 °C water for 20 °C outside
data_description.c2_vertex_offset: Shift of the whole curve (-10 to +10 °C). Leave empty for none

error.incomplete_curve: Fill in every value of this circuit's curve, or none of them.
error.high_ambient_not_above_low: The high ambient temperature must be above the low ambient temperature.

abort.not_loaded: The integration must be loaded to read which heating curves the unit uses. Try again once it has started.
abort.no_heating_curve: None of the circuits uses a points or gradient heating curve, so there is nothing to describe. A fixed water temperature already has its own entity.
